chunks: But you will not desire except as God wills. Verily He is all-knowing and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between human will and God's will in Surah Al-Insan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the doctrine of 'Amr bayn al-Amrayn' (the matter between the two matters), reconciling human agency with divine omnipotence by affirming that our choices are real but contingent upon Allah's overarching will. The attribution of 'Alim' (All-Knowing) and 'Hakim' (All-Wise) underscores that divine decree is not arbitrary but rooted in perfect knowledge and purposeful wisdom, a key distinction in Usuli theology.
